note: Score = sum of weight x learned multiplier for each confluence tag present. Highest score wins. Base weights are hand-set; learned_multipliers are written by the 4:15 review from closed paper trades.

ml.note: shadow: predicts and logs, never acts. veto: may only SKIP an entry, and only after min_trades_to_act closed trades AND beating the base rate walk-forward. It can never add an order, resize a contract or bypass the gate.
